Verified routes, components, data-testids, Formspree wiring, footer contact links, FAQ accordion, mobile menu, and consultation form validation via static code analysis. Live Playwright/UI run was not completed due to token budget exhaustion before browser automation could be invoked; main agent should self-verify in-browser.
